about: LDA+PLDA for VBx clustering with wespeaker_en_voxceleb_resnet34_LM.onnx. Trained by eval/plda-train.js on 5793 embeddings of 146 LibriSpeech readers (dev-clean, test-clean, dev-other, test-other; LibriSpeech by V. Panayotov et al., CC BY 4.0, openslr.org/12), clean and simulated call/phone crops of 2-8 s.
